**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip Handlebars control validation for objects read from Superset**

When a stored Handlebars chart has an absent, null, or empty `handlebarsTemplate`, reading it succeeds but saving it unchanged now fails: this unconditional `.strip()` either raises `AttributeError` or rejects the stored value. The aggregate-control check below likewise rejects previously stored empty selections. `ApiModel._check_tree()` invokes this validation during serialization, so these checks need the same `_read_from_superset` guard used by `Option.validate()` to preserve the read-and-save contract.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Initialize absent annotation lists before appending a layer**

When adding a formula annotation to a chart read from Superset whose params or stored `form_data` omit `annotation_layers`, this comprehension iterates a `MissingField` sentinel and raises `TypeError`. `ApiModel.model_post_init()` deliberately replaces absent fields with that sentinel, so the declared list default does not protect this path. Normalize a non-list annotation value to an editable list before appending, as the existing groupby and adhoc-filter builders do; otherwise the new helper cannot annotate these existing charts and can leave params partially modified if only the form-data update fails.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard the axis update when the stored query context is null**

For a scatter chart read from Superset with a null `query_context` (for example, an imported chart never saved through Explore), `Chart.from_json()` deliberately preserves that value as `None`. Calling `set_x_axis()` then updates params but raises `AttributeError` here, preventing callers from editing the axis before deriving a fresh query context. Update the stored form data only when a query context exists, as the new annotation and Handlebars helpers already do.

causal_evidence: The base-to-head diff (1978a98c748133cfe2d10918b53f0041205e4885 to ff16830624957df67445f936d6d1d4d44f6f3fe9) adds supersetapiplus/charts/echarts_timeseries_scatter.py. Git blame attributes the new public setter and its unconditional dereference at lines 60–63 to f5509228c7eb3c50a66acf658b03f7760c375dba.
evidences: supersetapiplus/charts/charts.py:462–469 explicitly preserves a null query_context as None on deserialization.
supersetapiplus/charts/echarts_timeseries_scatter.py:60–63 updates params first and then accesses query_context.form_data unconditionally.

Reproduced at ff16830624957df67445f936d6d1d4d44f6f3fe9 without HTTP. Deserializing a scatter chart with query_context=None and calling set_x_axis("order_date") changed params.x_axis from "old_axis" to "order_date", then raised AttributeError at line 63.
supersetapiplus/charts/timeseries.py:152–162 updates stored form_data only when suitable form data exists.
payload.follow_up: Add a regression test that deserializes a scatter chart with a null query context, edits the axis without an exception, and verifies that the stored context remains null.
payload.headline: Scatter axis editing raises when the stored query context is null
payload.before: set_x_axis() changes params.x_axis, then raises AttributeError when the stored query context is null.
payload.after: set_x_axis() always updates params and mirrors the change into stored form_data only when it exists. A null query context stays null until regeneration is requested.
payload.motivation: Null is a supported state for charts read from Superset. The setter should let callers edit the axis before requesting regeneration, without raising after a partial update.
payload.reply: Confirmed with a deserialized scatter chart. `set_x_axis()` changes `params.x_axis` and then raises `AttributeError` because `query_context` is `None`. The setter should update `params` and mirror the change only when stored `form_data` exists, leaving a null context intact until regeneration.

causal_evidence: O arquivo supersetapiplus/charts/handlebars.py não existe na base 1978a98c748133cfe2d10918b53f0041205e4885. O commit f5509228c7eb3c50a66acf658b03f7760c375dba introduz o modelo Handlebars e, nas linhas 45–55, executa as duas validações sem distinguir objetos lidos do Superset.
O diff de ff16830624957df67445f936d6d1d4d44f6f3fe9 contra seu pai adiciona o retorno antecipado por _read_from_superset antes das duas validações. Esse commit já é o HEAD fornecido.
evidences: supersetapiplus/resources/repository.py:178–187 e supersetapiplus/core/api_model.py:135–148,173–180 mostram que save() serializa e valida os modelos aninhados antes do PUT.

A reprodução local por to_json() com o método original falhou nos quatro casos: template ausente, nulo, vazio e seleção agregada vazia com template válido. Com o método do HEAD, todos os quatro preservaram integralmente os params.

supersetapiplus/charts/handlebars.py:45–57 limita o desvio aos objetos lidos do Superset. A execução de tests/unit/test_scatter_and_handlebars.py passou nos 17 testes, incluindo o que mantém a validação para gráficos construídos em código.
payload.headline: A validação de Handlebars impedia salvar gráficos lidos do Superset e já foi corrigida
payload.before: Ao serializar um gráfico armazenado, um template ausente ou nulo causava AttributeError. Um template vazio ou uma seleção agregada vazia com template válido causava ValidationError.
payload.after: O HEAD pula as duas verificações específicas para gráficos lidos do Superset e continua a aplicá-las aos gráficos construídos em código.
payload.motivation: Salvar sem alterações um gráfico lido do Superset deve preservar seus valores armazenados e não reaplicar as regras de criação.
payload.reply: O defeito foi introduzido em f550922 e já está corrigido em ff16830. Confirmei que os quatro casos citados agora serializam os parâmetros sem alterações e que gráficos novos continuam sujeitos às duas validações. Não é necessária outra alteração.
payload.ca_dod_impact: A entrega original violava o contrato de leitura e gravação sem perdas. O HEAD restaura esse contrato nos quatro casos verificados.

causal_evidence: Commit f5509228c7eb3c50a66acf658b03f7760c375dba introduced both the public add_formula_annotation() helper and the direct iteration over self.annotation_layers in TimeseriesOptionsMixin.add_annotation_layer().

supersetapiplus/core/api_model.py:111-117 replaces omitted fields with MissingField on read. supersetapiplus/charts/timeseries.py:158-162 updates params before calling the same builder on stored form_data, which explains the partial mutation when only form_data omits the field.
Commit ff16830624957df67445f936d6d1d4d44f6f3fe9 normalizes non-list values in the shared builder and is already present at both supplied HEADs.
evidences: An in-memory comparison using Chart.from_json() and the builder from each revision reproduced TypeError with the original builder when params, stored form_data, or both omitted annotation_layers. Params was partially modified only when stored form_data alone omitted the field. With the HEAD builder, both fields were updated in all three cases.
supersetapiplus/charts/timeseries.py:125-131 uses an empty list when the current value is not a list.
tests/unit/test_scatter_and_handlebars.py:143-149 verifies that both fields receive the layer when both lists are absent. The focused formula annotation test run passed all 8 selected tests.
payload.headline: Missing annotation lists caused a TypeError in the original delivery and are already handled at HEAD
payload.before: The builder iterated MissingField. When only stored form_data omitted annotation_layers, the call raised after changing params.
payload.after: Both params and stored form_data use the shared builder, which starts from an empty list when annotation_layers is absent and preserves existing lists when present.
payload.motivation: The original bug prevented callers from adding formula annotations to saved charts with omitted annotation lists. The supplied HEAD already fixes the reported cases.
payload.reply: Confirmed on f5509228. An omitted annotation list raised TypeError, and when only stored form_data omitted it, params had already changed. The fix is already in ff168306. I verified that the helper updates both fields when either or both lists are absent, and the regression test passes.
